phase3_findings.description: The supported database URL scheme rule is written four times with different checks: DatabaseConfig._supported_url_scheme accepts only mysql, mysql+... and sqlite..., while build_sql_runner (factory.py), probe_database (preflight.py) and sqlglot_dialect_for_url (readonly.py) test only startswith('mysql'), so a mysqlx:// URL that skips config validation still builds a MySQL runner.

The _SQLGLOT_DIALECT_MAP comment in eval/compare.py says it translates URL schemes, but its remaining keys mssql and mariadb can no longer reach it because config loading refuses both schemes; the mariadb entry also hints at MariaDB support the project rules out.

The new mysql/sleep(0) row of test_call_after_nested_comment_markers_is_checked is refused by the nested-comment check before the function denylist runs, so it does not test what the test name says and duplicates coverage at lines 1145 and 1178; the sqlite row still covers the denylist path.

verify_base_tables returns without a log line or refusal for a function-only query under a dialect with no table entry; acceptance criterion 9 requires this, only a custom runner under RlsGuardRunner can reach it, and the docstring does not mention the pass-through.
configuration.md, README.md and the changelog fragment say any mysql+<driver>:// URL loads but do not say the driver name is ignored and PyMySQL is always used.
docs/internal/index.md line 34 now has a singular subject ('the MySQL SqlRunner implementation') but still says 'what they log when they do'.
